csv-to-json.html.intro_h2: What is the CSV to JSON Tool?

Our converter bridges this gap by parsing your spreadsheet data and turning it into a clean JSON array or object. It automatically detects headers and handles complex quoting, all within your browser.

Choose your output preference: 'Array of Objects' or 'Array of Arrays'.
Click 'Convert' and copy or download the resulting JSON instantly.
faq: Does it support custom delimiters?
Yes, you can specify if your file uses semicolons (;), tabs, or other characters as separators.

Absolutely. All parsing is done locally using JavaScript. Your data never leaves your computer.
Does it handle headers?
Yes. By default, the first row is used as the keys for the JSON objects.
Can I convert large files?
Yes, you can process several thousand rows of data instantly right in your browser tab.

favicon-generator.html.benefit: Create Browser Icons for All Devices
favicon-generator.html.desc_meta: Generate favicons in all standard sizes from a single image. Support for Apple and Android icons. Free online favicon generator.
favicon-generator.html.sub: Turn any image into a complete set of browser and mobile app icons.
favicon-generator.html.intro_p: A favicon is the little icon that appears in the browser tab next to your website's title. It's crucial for branding and helps users identify your site among many tabs. Our tool generates every size you need—from 16x16 pixels to high-res mobile app icons.
steps: Upload your square source image (at least 512x512 recommended).
Wait for the tool to generate the various package sizes (ICO, PNG, and Manifest).
Download the 'Favicon Pack' ZIP and follow the instructions to add it to your site.
faq: What sizes are included?
The pack includes 16x16, 32x32, 180x180 (Apple), and 192x192/512x512 (Android/PWA) icons.
Which format should I use?

Is my image safe?
Yes. The resizing happens locally in your browser. We do not store or process your icons on our server.
Do I need a square image?
Yes. For best results, use a square image to avoid stretching during the generation process.

typing-speed-test.html.intro_p: Words Per Minute (WPM) is measured by taking the number of characters typed divided by five (the average word length) and then dividing by the time taken. Our tool tracks this live, excluding errors, to give you a true measure of your typing performance.
steps: Select your test duration (1, 2, or 5 minutes).
Start typing the highlighted text as fast and accurately as possible.
Review your final WPM, Accuracy %, and total errors once the timer hits zero.
faq: What is a good WPM score?
The average typing speed is around 40 WPM. Professional typists often score between 65 and 80 WPM.
Do errors reduce my score?
Yes, accuracy is as important as speed. Errors are tracked and deducted from your average speed.
Is it free to use?
Yes, you can take the test as many times as you like to practice and improve.
Can I use it on a tablet?
For the best experience, we recommend using a physical keyboard, as touch screens are not ideal for WPM testing.
